oracle: symmetric explicit-zero CSR eight-neighbour pixel arcs; per-node all-boundary multi-source Dijkstra; Floyd min-max
distance_checks: root beta finite/+inf status and numeric values; NaN/-inf are failures; not each pair or drawing path
owner_check: every independent boundary source must retain its original node owner
random_generator: independent recorded per-case seeds; 4-pixel cells with a background moat; 1..3-pixel rectangles; no discarded cases

roi.center: first predicted shoot 8CC centroid; image center if no shoot
roi.rounding: floor centroid, subtract 128, clip window origin to image bounds
roi.skip: more than 80 occupied nodes or no root; no replacement
roi.purpose: cropped graph algorithm validation, not full-image performance

benchmark.layout: same seeded input in each repeat; 4x4 grid of 3x3 nodes
benchmark.radius: size (full pixel domain), separate synthetic scaling protocol
benchmark.oracle_ms: independent domain + CSR + all source propagations + complete distances + Floyd total
benchmark.interpretation: paired implementations, not system speedup; no stage timing or memory estimates
